result.title: Autonomous Continual Learning and Knowledge Transfer via Cortex-Inspired Neural Assemblies
result.summary: Unlike the brain, artificial neural networks (ANNs) suffer from "catastrophic forgetting": complete overwriting of solutions when re-training on new functions ("concept shift") or on a disjoint domain of the current function ("domain shift"). ANNs require each batch of data to be roughly representative of the complete distribution, a typically expensive and impractical requirement. In this paper, we introduce Functional Task Networks (FTNs), a method of continual learning and knowledge transfer modeled after several properties of the mammalian neocortex. FTN is formulated as a distributed, stochastic mixture of experts in which a sparse, binary routing mask is computed at inference time using a small support sample of input-output pairs. Per-batch reconfiguration of the router during training, together with mask-overlap-filtered replay, shapes a basis of overlapping, partially trained subnetworks. Unrelated tasks route through mostly separate assemblies, related tasks overlap on shared components. On block-sequentially trained continual learning and knowledge transfer tasks FTN retains solutions nearly as well as disjoint-mask isolation and attains the lowest pre-update head-start loss among matched-architecture comparators. The learned mask-overlap geometry tracks the known concept-sharing structure where available. We show experimentally that under correlated concept shift, support-set mask reconfiguration is necessary even for retention. Under domain shift, the distributed bank with replay is sufficient to handle retention without the configurer. Forward transfer, or head-start, and backward transfer, are also contributed by support-set mask configuration.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 Functional Task Networks，一种仿皮层的分布式随机混合专家结构：推理时用少量 support 输入-输出样本计算稀疏二值路由掩码，训练中逐批重配置路由器并结合掩码重叠过滤回放，形成部分重叠的子网络基，以缓解灾难性遗忘并实现前后向迁移。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「用少量支持样本在推理时选择子网络」的动态路由机制，可能为 LVR 中按任务/证据动态分配计算与选择视觉信息的模块化推理提供借鉴；掩码重叠几何作为概念共享结构的诊断量，也值得核查是否能刻画 latent 表示的相似与共享程度。
